name: Alectinib
mechanism: Highly selective ATP-competitive ALK inhibitor active against several crizotinib-resistant mutations (e.g. L1196M). It is not a P-glycoprotein substrate, enabling high CNS penetration.
interactions: Take with food. Few clinically significant CYP interactions; advise sun protection.
resistance: G1202R solvent-front mutation and other ALK mutations (I1171X); bypass activation including MET amplification. Lorlatinib is commonly used after progression.
